augments.name: Chakra Efficiency
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first skill you use each battle that costs 2 or more chakra costs 1 less random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the first skill your team uses that costs 2 or more chakra costs 1 less random chakra.

augments.name: Iron Skin
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters begin each battle with 10 destructible defense.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each living ninja starts every battle with 10 destructible defense.

augments.name: Precision Training
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first damaging skill each character uses deals 5 additional damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each ninja's first damaging skill in a battle deals 5 additional damage.

augments.name: Medical Training
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your healing skills restore 5 additional health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' skills that heal restore 5 additional health (per heal effect).

augments.name: Chakra Reserves
augments.descriptionOriginal: Begin each battle with 1 additional random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Begin each battle with 1 additional random chakra.

augments.name: Steady Hands
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters' skills that deal 10 or less damage deal 5 additional damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Damage effects with a base of 10 or less deal 5 additional damage.

augments.name: Defensive Stance
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character uses a skill that deals no damage, they gain 5 damage reduction for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja uses a skill with no damage effect, they gain 5 damage reduction for 1 turn.

augments.name: Second Wind
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each character falls below 50 health, they heal 10 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the first time each ninja drops to 49 health or less from damage, they heal 10.

augments.name: Quick Recovery
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each character is stunned, reduce the duration of that stun by 1 turn, to a minimum of 0.
augments.descriptionNormalized: The first time each ninja is stunned (full or partial), that stun lasts 1 turn less; a 1-turn stun is ignored.

augments.name: Reinforced Armor
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your destructible defense gains 5 additional points whenever it is applied.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Destructible defense your ninjas' skills grant to your team gains 5 points.

augments.name: Chakra Discipline
augments.descriptionOriginal: Once per battle, spending 3 or more chakra in one turn refunds 1 random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, when your team has spent 3 or more chakra in one turn, gain 1 random chakra.

augments.name: Tactical Advantage
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters deal 5 additional damage to enemies affected by a stun.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' skill hits deal 5 additional damage to a stunned enemy.

augments.name: Poisoned Weapons
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first physical damaging skill each character uses deals 5 affliction damage for 2 turns.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each ninja's first Physical skill that damages enemies poisons them: 5 affliction damage each turn for 2 turns.

augments.name: Battle Hardened
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters gain 5 damage reduction while below 50 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas have 5 damage reduction while at 49 health or less.

augments.name: Sharpened Kunai
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your physical skills deal 5 additional damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' Physical skills deal 5 additional damage.

augments.name: Focused Chakra
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your chakra skills deal 5 additional damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' Chakra skills deal 5 additional damage.

augments.name: Mental Clarity
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your mental skills cost 1 less random chakra the first time they are used each battle, if they have a random chakra cost.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each Mental skill with a random cost costs 1 less random chakra the first time that ninja uses it in a battle (minimum 1 total).

augments.name: Lingering Pain
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your affliction damage is increased by 5 per damage instance, once per target per turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per enemy per turn, your affliction damage to them deals 5 more affliction damage.

augments.name: Protective Instinct
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an ally dies, surviving allies gain 10 destructible defense.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When one of your ninjas dies, the survivors gain 10 destructible defense.

augments.name: Opportunist
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters deal 5 additional damage to enemies below 50 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' skill hits deal 5 additional damage to an enemy below 50 health.

augments.name: Chakra Leech
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each turn your team deals affliction damage, gain 1 random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, when your team deals affliction damage, gain 1 random chakra.

augments.name: Bloodthirsty
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character deals direct damage, they heal for 20% of the damage dealt, rounded down. Maximum 15 healing per turn per character.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas heal 20% (rounded down) of the direct damage they deal, up to 15 per ninja per turn.

augments.name: Shadow Clone Training
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first damaging skill used by each character each battle repeats, dealing 50% of its original damage to the same target. Secondary effects do not repeat.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each ninja's first damaging skill in a battle repeats 50% of its damage on the same targets. Only the damage repeats.

augments.name: Explosive Tags
augments.descriptionOriginal: Every third damaging skill your team uses deals 10 additional damage to all enemies.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Every third damaging skill your team uses also deals 10 damage to every enemy (invulnerable enemies are skipped).

augments.name: Unbreakable Will
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each character would be stunned, prevent the stun and gain 10 damage reduction for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: The first stun that would affect each ninja is prevented, and that ninja gains 10 damage reduction for 1 turn.

augments.name: Forbidden Knowledge
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your skills with cooldowns of 3 or more have their cooldowns reduced by 1 turn, excluding invulnerability skills.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Skills with a cooldown of 3 or more recover 1 turn sooner, except skills that grant invulnerability.

augments.name: Chain Lightning
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a chakra skill deals direct damage to an enemy, deal 10 damage to a different random enemy. Once per character per turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per ninja per turn, a Chakra skill that deals direct damage also deals 10 damage to a different random enemy.

augments.name: Relentless Assault
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character uses a damaging skill on consecutive turns, increase their direct damage by 5, stacking up to 20. Reset when they use a non-damaging skill.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Using a damaging skill on consecutive turns gives that ninja +5 direct damage, up to +20. A non-damaging skill or a skipped turn resets it.

augments.name: Executioner's Mark
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character damages an enemy below 30 health, deal 10 additional piercing damage. Once per target per turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per enemy per turn, hitting an enemy who is left below 30 health deals 10 more piercing damage to them.

augments.name: Emergency Healing
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each battle an ally falls below 25 health, heal them for 20 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the first time one of your ninjas drops below 25 health and survives, they heal 20.

augments.name: Chakra Conversion
augments.descriptionOriginal: Once per turn, when your team spends 2 chakra of the same type, gain 1 random chakra of a different type.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, when your team has spent 2 chakra of the same type, gain 1 random chakra of another type.

augments.name: Sand Armor
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character gains destructible defense, they also gain 10 damage reduction for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Whenever a ninja's destructible defense rises (including at battle start), they gain 10 damage reduction for 1 turn.

augments.name: Venomous Touch
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character deals affliction damage, reduce the target's healing received by 25% for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Affliction damage from your team cuts the target's healing received by 25% for 1 turn.

augments.name: Sharingan Insight
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time an enemy successfully damages each character, that character's next damaging skill against that enemy deals 15 additional damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: The first enemy to damage each ninja is marked for them: that ninja's next damaging skill on that enemy deals 15 more damage.

augments.name: Perfect Timing
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character successfully counters an enemy skill, reduce the cooldown of one of their other skills by 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When one of your counters stops an enemy skill, that ninja's longest remaining cooldown drops by 1.

augments.name: Desperate Measures
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters deal 20% additional direct damage while below 30 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: While at 29 health or less, a ninja's direct (non-affliction) skill hits deal 20% more damage, rounded down.

augments.name: Chakra Overload
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character uses a skill costing 3 or more chakra, deal 10 piercing damage to a random enemy.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja uses a skill that cost 3 or more chakra, a random enemy takes 10 piercing damage.

augments.name: Vengeful Spirit
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an ally dies, your surviving characters permanently deal 10 additional damage for the remainder of the battle.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas deal 10 additional damage for each dead ally in this battle.

augments.name: Guardian's Oath
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character heals an ally, both gain 10 destructible defense.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja heals an ally, both gain 10 destructible defense.

augments.name: Lingering Genjutsu
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first stun each character applies each battle lasts 1 additional turn, to a maximum of 2 turns total.
augments.descriptionNormalized: The first stun each ninja applies in a battle lasts 1 turn longer, to at most 2 turns.

augments.name: Predator's Instinct
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an enemy dies, reduce all your living characters' active cooldowns by 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When an enemy dies, each of your living ninjas' longest remaining cooldown drops by 1.

augments.name: Unstable Chakra
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the start of each battle, gain 3 random chakra. At the end of your first turn, lose up to 2 unspent chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Begin each battle with 3 additional random chakra; at the end of your first turn, lose up to 2 random unspent chakra.

augments.name: Thousand Cuts
augments.descriptionOriginal: Each time a character damages the same enemy with a new skill, increase their damage against that enemy by 5, stacking up to 20.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each new skill a ninja hits an enemy with adds +5 damage against that enemy for that ninja, up to +20.

augments.name: Resilient Defense
augments.descriptionOriginal: When a character's destructible defense is destroyed, they gain 15 damage reduction for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja's destructible defense is fully destroyed, they gain 15 damage reduction for 1 turn.

augments.name: Chakra Suppression
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each turn your team stuns an enemy, increase that enemy's next skill cost by 1 random chakra for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, the first enemy your team stuns has its skills cost 1 additional random chakra for 1 turn.

augments.name: Perfect Synchronization
augments.descriptionOriginal: When two or more allies damage the same enemy in one turn, the second and subsequent attacks deal 10 additional damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When an enemy has already been hit by another of your ninjas this turn, further hits on them deal 10 more damage.

augments.name: Rejuvenation
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the end of each turn, heal each character for 5 health if they did not take damage that turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the end of each of your turns, each ninja who took no damage since your last turn ended heals 5.

augments.name: Piercing Focus
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters' first direct damaging skill each turn ignores 10 points of damage reduction.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' direct hits ignore up to 10 of the target's flat damage reduction.

augments.name: Unfinished Business
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time an enemy survives a damaging skill with 10 or less health, deal 5 additional piercing damage to them.
augments.descriptionNormalized: The first time each enemy survives one of your skills at 10 health or less, they take 5 piercing damage.

augments.name: Unrelenting Pressure
augments.descriptionOriginal: Enemies damaged by your team on consecutive turns receive 10% additional direct damage from your team, stacking up to 30%. Resets after a turn without damage.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Enemies your team damages on consecutive turns take +10% direct damage per extra turn, up to +30%. A turn without damage resets it.

augments.name: Edo Tensei
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each battle an ally dies, revive them at the start of your next turn with 30 health. Each character can be revived only once.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the first of your ninjas to die returns at the start of your next turn with 30 health.

augments.name: Eight Gates
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters deal 50% additional direct damage, but take 10 affliction damage that ignores invulnerability at the end of each turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' direct (non-affliction) skill hits deal 50% more damage, rounded down. Each ninja loses 10 health at the end of your turn (health loss ignores invulnerability, damage reduction and destructible defense).

augments.name: Infinite Chakra
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first skill each character uses each turn costs 1 less random chakra, or 1 less chakra of a required type if no random cost exists. Minimum cost: 1 chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each ninja's skills that cost 2 or more cost 1 less chakra (random first, otherwise one required chakra; minimum 1).

augments.name: Izanagi
augments.descriptionOriginal: Once per battle, the first time your team would lose its final living character, prevent that character's death and restore them to 50 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, when your last living ninja would die, they are restored to 50 health instead.

augments.name: Six Paths Power
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters' direct damage ignores damage reduction and destructible defense. It does not ignore invulnerability.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' direct skill damage ignores damage reduction and destructible defense, but not invulnerability.

augments.name: Perfect Susanoo
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters begin each battle with 30 destructible defense and 10 damage reduction.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each living ninja starts every battle with 30 destructible defense, and your ninjas have 10 damage reduction.

augments.name: Infinite Tsukuyomi
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the beginning of turn 4, stun all enemies for 1 turn. This effect occurs once per battle and cannot be extended.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of your fourth turn, every enemy is stunned for 1 turn (once per battle; cannot be extended).

augments.name: Rinne Rebirth
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an ally dies, all surviving allies heal for 25 health and gain 1 random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When one of your ninjas dies, the survivors heal 25 and your team gains 1 random chakra.

augments.name: Amaterasu
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each turn your team damages an enemy, apply 10 affliction damage for 2 turns. This effect does not stack.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, the first enemy your team damages burns for 10 affliction damage each turn for 2 turns (does not stack).

augments.name: Flying Thunder God
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first harmful skill targeting each character every 3 turns is countered. This does not counter skills that ignore counters.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each ninja starts with a hidden counter against the next harmful skill targeting them; after it triggers it re-arms 3 turns later.

augments.name: The Will of Fire
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an ally dies, surviving allies permanently gain 15 additional direct damage and 10 damage reduction for the remainder of the battle.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each dead ally gives your surviving ninjas +15 damage and 10 damage reduction for the rest of the battle.

augments.name: Reaper Death Seal
augments.descriptionOriginal: Once per battle, when an enemy kills one of your characters, that enemy takes 40 piercing damage that ignores invulnerability.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the enemy who kills one of your ninjas takes 40 piercing damage that ignores invulnerability.

augments.name: Ten-Tails Chakra
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the start of every third turn, gain 2 random chakra and heal all allies for 10 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of every third turn of yours, gain 2 random chakra and every ninja heals 10.

augments.name: Forbidden Regeneration
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the start of each turn, your characters heal for 10 health. Healing is doubled while below 30 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of each of your turns, every ninja heals 10 (20 while below 30 health).

augments.name: Kotoamatsukami
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each battle an enemy uses a harmful skill, counter that skill and stun its user for 1 turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the first harmful skill an enemy aims at your team is countered and its user is stunned for 1 turn.

augments.name: Indra's Wrath
augments.descriptionOriginal: Every fourth damaging skill your team uses deals an additional 30 piercing damage to its primary target.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Every fourth damaging skill your team uses deals 30 more piercing damage to its first target.

augments.name: Asura's Blessing
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character heals an ally, all other living allies are healed for 50% of the amount restored, rounded down.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja's skill heals an ally, every other living ally heals half that amount (rounded down).

augments.name: Sage Mode
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters' damaging skills deal 15 additional damage, and their healing skills restore 10 additional health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' skill damage effects deal 15 additional damage, and their skills that heal restore 10 additional health (per heal effect).

augments.name: Chakra Absorption
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each turn an enemy uses a skill costing 2 or more chakra, gain 1 random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, when an enemy uses a skill that cost 2 or more chakra, gain 1 random chakra.

augments.name: The Last Stand
augments.descriptionOriginal: When only one ally remains alive, that character gains 50% additional direct damage, 20 damage reduction, and heals 10 health at the start of each turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: While only one of your ninjas lives, they deal 50% more direct damage, have 20 damage reduction, and heal 10 at the start of your turns.

augments.name: Impure Resurrection
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first ally to die each battle returns with 50 health after 1 turn, but permanently loses 10 maximum health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, the first of your ninjas to die returns at the start of your next turn with 50 health and 10 less maximum health for the battle.

augments.name: Forbidden Experimentation
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the beginning of each battle, randomly gain one of three effects: +25% direct damage, +15 damage reduction, or +10 healing per turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of each battle, a seeded roll gives your ninjas one of: +25% direct damage, 15 damage reduction, or 10 healing at the end of each turn.

augments.name: Heavenly Restriction
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your physical skills deal 50% additional direct damage, but your chakra and mental skills cost 1 additional random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' Physical skills deal 50% more direct (non-affliction) damage, rounded down. Their Chakra and Mental skills cost 1 additional random chakra (+1 total for a skill that is both).

augments.name: Chakra Devourer
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an enemy dies, gain 2 random chakra and permanently increase your team's direct damage by 5 for the remainder of the battle.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When an enemy dies, gain 2 random chakra and your ninjas gain +5 direct damage for the rest of the battle (stacking).

augments.name: The Immortal Body
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters cannot be reduced below 1 health during the first 2 turns of each battle.
augments.descriptionNormalized: For the first 2 turns of each battle (the engine's 2-turn status timer), your ninjas cannot be reduced below 1 health.

augments.name: Shadow Clone Army
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first direct damaging skill each character uses every 3 turns repeats at 50% damage against a random living enemy. Secondary effects do not repeat.
augments.descriptionNormalized: A ninja's direct damaging skill repeats 50% of its damage on a random living enemy, at most once every 3 of their turns.

augments.name: Forbidden Pact
augments.descriptionOriginal: Your characters deal 40% additional direct damage, but healing received is reduced by 50%.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Your ninjas' direct (non-affliction) skill hits deal 40% more damage, rounded down; healing they receive is halved.

augments.name: The Perfect Vessel
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character gains a temporary damage or defense boost, increase its duration by 1 turn, to a maximum of 4 turns.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Temporary damage and defense boosts your ninjas gain last 1 turn longer, to at most 4 turns.

augments.name: Chakra Singularity
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever your team spends 5 chakra, refund 2 random chakra. This can trigger once per turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, when your team has spent 5 chakra, gain 2 random chakra.

augments.name: The Final Technique
augments.descriptionOriginal: When a character dies, they deal 25 piercing damage to all enemies. This effect ignores invulnerability and can trigger only once per character per battle.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When one of your ninjas dies, every enemy takes 25 piercing damage that ignores invulnerability (once per ninja).

augments.name: Chakra Roulette
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the beginning of each turn, randomly select one chakra type. Skills costing that type cost 1 less chakra this turn, minimum 1 total.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of each of your turns, a seeded roll picks a chakra type; skills that cost it cost 1 less of it this turn (minimum 1 total).

augments.name: Cursed Seal
augments.descriptionOriginal: Each time a character uses a damaging skill, they gain 5 additional direct damage, stacking up to 30. They also take 5 affliction damage at the end of each turn while they have stacks.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each damaging skill gives that ninja +5 direct damage, up to +30; while they have any, they take 5 affliction damage at the end of your turn.

augments.name: Double Casting
augments.descriptionOriginal: Every third chakra skill your team uses repeats its direct damage at 50% effectiveness. Secondary effects do not repeat.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Every third Chakra skill your team uses repeats 50% of its direct damage on the same targets. Only the damage repeats.

augments.name: Living Weapon
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character deals 25 or more direct damage with one skill, they gain 10 destructible defense.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja deals 25 or more direct damage with one skill, they gain 10 destructible defense.

augments.name: The Gambler
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the beginning of each turn, randomly gain either 2 chakra or take 15 piercing damage to a random ally.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of each of your turns, a seeded roll either gives 2 random chakra or deals 15 piercing damage to a random ninja of yours.

augments.name: Blood Sacrifice
augments.needs: Blocked: "may instead spend 15 health" is a choice made while queuing a skill, which needs a new prompt in the battle client and a new WebSocket field. Changing the protocol needs your approval.
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character uses a skill costing 2 or more chakra, they may instead spend 15 health to reduce its cost by 1 random chakra.

augments.name: Reverse Summoning
augments.descriptionOriginal: Once per battle, when a character would die, remove them from combat for 1 turn. They return with 25 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, a ninja who would die returns at 25 health but is removed from combat (cannot act or be hit) for 1 turn.

augments.name: Mirror Technique
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character successfully counters a damaging skill, reflect 50% of its original direct damage to the attacker.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When one of your counters stops a damaging enemy skill, its user takes half of that skill's base direct damage.

augments.name: Unstable Evolution
augments.descriptionOriginal: Every 3 turns, your characters randomly gain +10 direct damage, +10 damage reduction, or 15 destructible defense for 2 turns.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of every third turn of yours, a seeded roll gives every ninja +10 direct damage or 10 damage reduction for 2 turns, or 15 destructible defense.

augments.name: Perfect Balance
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever your team uses a physical, chakra, and mental skill in the same turn, refund 2 random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per turn, when your team has used a Physical, a Chakra and a Mental skill, gain 2 random chakra.

augments.name: Death Mark
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever your team damages the same enemy on 3 consecutive turns, deal 30 piercing damage to that enemy. Reset the count afterward.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When your team damages the same enemy on 3 consecutive turns, they take 30 piercing damage and the count restarts.

augments.name: The Puppet Master's Art
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character applies a harmful effect lasting 2 or more turns, extend that effect by 1 turn, maximum once per application.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Harmful effects of 2 or more turns that your ninjas apply last 1 turn longer.

augments.name: Forbidden Transfusion
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character receives healing at full health, convert up to 20 excess healing into destructible defense.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When a ninja is healed to full, up to 20 of the excess healing becomes destructible defense.

augments.name: Soul Link
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever a character takes direct damage, distribute 30% of that damage evenly among their living allies instead.
augments.descriptionNormalized: 30% of each enemy direct hit on one of your ninjas is moved off them and split evenly among their living allies as piercing damage.

augments.name: Chakra Burn
augments.descriptionOriginal: Whenever an enemy spends chakra, deal 5 affliction damage to them for each chakra spent, up to 15 per turn.
augments.descriptionNormalized: When an enemy uses a skill, they take 5 affliction damage per chakra it cost, up to 15 per enemy per turn.

augments.name: The Copy Ninja
augments.needs: Blocked: granting a temporary copied skill needs a fifth, dynamic skill slot in the battle client and protocol. Changing the protocol needs your approval.
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each battle an enemy damages one of your characters, grant that character a temporary copy of the direct damage portion of that skill, usable once for 1 random chakra.

augments.name: Elemental Mastery
augments.descriptionOriginal: Each time your team uses a chakra skill, increase subsequent chakra skill damage by 5 for the remainder of the battle, stacking up to 30.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Each Chakra skill your team uses gives all your ninjas +5 Chakra-skill damage for the rest of the battle, up to +30.

augments.name: Last Breath
augments.descriptionOriginal: The first time each battle a character would die, they remain alive at 1 health until the end of their next turn, then die unless healed above 1 health.
augments.descriptionNormalized: Once per battle, a ninja who would die stays at 1 health until the end of your next turn, then dies unless healed above 1.

augments.name: Forbidden Exchange
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the beginning of each battle, your team loses 30 total health distributed evenly among living allies and gains 4 random chakra.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of each battle, your living ninjas lose 30 health split evenly (rounded down, never below 1 health) and your team gains 4 random chakra.

augments.name: The Tower's Blessing
augments.descriptionOriginal: At the beginning of each battle, gain the effects of two random Common Scrolls you do not already possess.
augments.descriptionNormalized: At the start of each battle, your team also gains the effects of two operational Common augments it does not own, chosen by the run seed for that floor.
